data: What transformations are applied to the audio and character temporal softmax inputs to obtain the modality encodings?

The caption states that the audio and character temporal softmax inputs are transformed into their respective modality encodings through convolutional transformations. From the figure, we can see that these transformations are represented by the functions \( f_a(\cdot) \) and \( f_s(\cdot) \), which are applied to the audio and character temporal softmax inputs, respectively. These functions are shown as blue and red boxes in the figure, indicating the application of the convolutional transformations. Therefore, the transformations applied to the audio and character temporal softmax inputs to obtain the modality encodings are the convolutional transformations \( f_a(\cdot) \) and \( f_s(\cdot) \).
